column1: # PSG PDF's own interface strings in ja, appended to the craft-i18n catalog at build time
# (crates/ui-egui/build.rs). Same format: context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation.
# Written from the plain meaning of the English; no other product's translations were consulted.

column2: No signature font can draw “{char}”. Use other letters, or draw or import your signature.
column3: 「{char}」を描ける署名フォントがありません。別の文字を使うか、手書きまたは画像の署名を使ってください。
